name: Test: a subworld from a .wld file (C#)
author: test
summary: Enters the Example Mod arena loaded from ExampleArena.wld, checks its blocks, walls, name and difficulty, and that a temporary copy starts over on the next trip.
description: Compile with tools/tests/build-cs.sh cssubwld and run with SAMPLE=1. Logs cssubwld <case>: ok | FAIL and cssubwld END pass=N fail=M.
